why: Drawing a goal region should lead directly into naming it, without losing the inspector during saves.
verdict: pass for exercised region draw/name/history flow
changes: Successful drawing opens the new region and focuses/selects its name.
Region details retain their current expanded state during rerenders.
observations: Trusted pointer drag produces exact inclusive 4 by 3 cell region at 25,33.
Name field receives focus and public typing sets its title.
Two undo steps remove name edit then draw; redo restores the exact authored definition.
Escape cancels a second unfinished rectangle without changing the current checkpoint or history.
Reload preserves exact checkpoint and one rendered region.
limits: Rectangle flow only; not goal dependency deletion, all region-boundary conditions or unfamiliar-player walkthrough.
Expanded details preserved during the editing session, not promised across reload.
